t3.text: Round 4 · Navi panel, tucked-away features, sentence sources

t4.text: Onboarding · sign in to your first plan (press Play on Sign in to click through)

t1.text: Round 2 · “Night Stone” (too corporate — kept for comparison)

t2.text: Round 2 · Focus, light variant, behavior prototype

s1.text:
Round 4 — from your notes:
1. My day's sentence only counts what's on the plan: “A full afternoon. 9½ hours planned, 3½ free — most of it before 2.” No claims about things Navi didn't do.
2. Timeline · Calendar toggle on My day. Calendar opens on Week (Day too); Timeline stays the default.
3. Navi panel states: knows the page you're on, keeps draft and voice when closed, quiet badge, Focus holds non-urgent items.
4. Tucked away: ⌘K palette (small search icon in the sidebar) and “More details” on a task (hard deadline, estimate, repeat, reminder).
5. Sources board: every Navi sentence, the data it's built from, what happens when data is missing, and what Navi never says.

s2.text:
Your calls:
• Calendar opens on Week — or remember the last view?
• Search icon in the sidebar for ⌘K: keep, or keyboard only?
• Focus: only fixed events within 10 min and hard deadlines break through. Right line?
• Task reminders and “Not now” on suggestions each need a small new database field. OK to add (local first)?
• Approve round 4 → I start building the desktop shell.

s3.text:
Onboarding — as agreed:
• Invite-only. Google, or email with a 6-digit code; a password is the optional second way. No email links.
• Unfinished setup always lands here, from any page, and picks up at the same step on any device.
• Steps: Hello · The basics (name, timezone, wake-up, bedtime) · Talk it through (text or voice, live “What Navi's picked up”) · Review (nothing real until you turn it on) · Stay in touch (morning briefing at your wake-up time, evening 9 PM, quiet hours bedtime → wake-up) · Your first plan.
• “Do this later” on every step → Home shows “Finish setting up Navi” until done.

t5.text: Mobile 1.5 · Structure — three pages, chat in the middle

s4.text:
Mobile structure, as agreed:
• Three pages: Progress ← Navi chat → Plan. Swipe, or tap the labels at the top.
• Chat in the middle; a slim now/next line on top; Navi's first line comes from your data.
• ☰ opens your chats; your account sits bottom-left of that drawer (Settings, Memory, Notes, Activity).
• Plan opens on Day. Day · Week · List switch. Inbox is the pinned row at the top → sheet.
• The stone on Progress and Plan takes you to the chat with "About · this page".
• Focus and voice cover all pages. Voice can shrink to a talking bar while you keep working.

Try: Plan → Fit it in; Talk → shrink → swipe; type something → it lands in Inbox.

t6.text: Mobile 1.5 · M1 Calmer — for review, not locked

s5.text:
M1 Calmer — what changed:
• One box style, only for things you act on (proposals, approvals). Everything else is text; brightness does the hierarchy.
• Page names are quiet text; a small dot on Plan when something waits. New chat moved into the ☰ drawer.
• Chat: a fresh session opens on the greeting + at most one suggestion. Resuming keeps the conversation and scroll position.
• Plan: week strip behind the title; earlier items folded; actions show only on the next or selected block; “Still needs a time” ends the day.
• Progress: one sentence, one chart, one next step.
• Ask Navi: a quiet handle at the bottom of Plan/Progress opens a sheet that knows the context, grows into the full chat, and closes back.

Try in the prototype: Plan → tap the essay → Ask Navi → send → Move it → close.
